notices.title: स्मार्ट कार्ड वितरण सम्बन्धी सूचना ।।
notices.content:
यातायात व्यवस्था विभाग, मिनभवन, काठमाण्डौबाट Backlog License हरु कार्यालयमा प्रिन्ट भई आएको र उक्त लाईसेन्सहरु वितरण गर्नकोलागि तयारी अवस्थामा रहेकोले सेवाग्राहीहरुले आफ्नो Smart Card आए नआएको एकिन गर्नको लागि तलको लिंकमा Click गर्नुहोला । 

यदि तपाईको लाईसेन्स आएको पाईएमा यस कार्यालयमा सोमबारदेखि शुक्रबारसम्म उल्लेखित शाखामा सम्पर्क राख्नु हुन अनुरोध गरिन्छ ।

notices.title: Smart Driving License Cards Available for Collection
notices.content: Smart cards are available in the offices so we announce you to all to contact in office to collect your smart cards. Please bring your original application slip/receipt, citizenship certificate, and valid identification to collect your printed smart driving license.

notices.title: Smart Card Distribution Schedule (Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM)
notices.content: Smart cards will be distributed by Monday to Friday from 9:30 to 4:30 in Department - क and Department - ख. All applicants are kindly requested to visit during these designated office hours.
